name: web-grid-system-spec-over-dark-editorial-portrait
title: Column grid spec with desktop and mobile bars over a darkened portrait
whatItIs: A darkened photo of two pale red-haired figures in vintage clothing sits behind a spec. An uppercase statement explains a 12-column desktop and 4-column mobile grid, then translucent vertical column bars show margins, gutters and pixel widths with small labels.
whatItMeans: Precise and moody; overlaying the grid on an editorial image makes an abstract rule feel cinematic.
techniques: Draw the layout grid as translucent bars over a dark photo.
Label margins, columns and gutters with hairline pointers.
Show desktop and mobile side by side.
Use an uppercase statement to summarise the rule.

vocabulary.definition: A set of vertical columns organising a layout.
The outer space beyond the columns.
Technical annotations placed on top of an image.
